# Sort vertices counter-clockwise around center using cross-product test [S7, unofficial]

The claim states that vertices are sorted counter-clockwise around the center using a cross-product test. The evidence in Source [S7] explicitly contains the code snippet `localVertexList.Sort( (Vector3 A, Vector3 B) =>{ if (Vector3.Dot(halfVector, Vector3.Cross(A-C, B-C)) <= 0 ){ return 1; } else{ return -1; } })`. This code implements a sorting algorithm based on the sign of the dot product of the half-vector and the cross product of vectors from the center `C` to vertices `A` and `B`, which is the standard method for determining counter-clockwise ordering in a plane defined by the half-vector. The notes also explicitly mention this step: 'Sort the resulting intersection vertices for the slice in counter-clockwise order around the center C using the cross-product test'. Therefore, every fact in the claim is present in the evidence.
